mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with UNRATE increase > 0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction that lowers corporate revenue expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with concurrent HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 index level signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in non-farm payrolls and rising unemployment indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in housing starts signals strong consumer confidence that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with 6-month HOUST increase, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) creates an accommodative monetary environment that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
